caption: The drawing depicts a single andiron, primarily colored in shades of yellow and gold with green and brown accents. The object has a bulbous, rounded top with a small finial, situated above a tall, column-like middle section. Below the central shaft, there is a scalloped, skirt-like detail above the base. The base itself consists of four curved legs, each ending in a small ball foot, radiating outward symmetrically. To the right of the column, a horizontal bar with a textured top edge extends and attaches to an upright post capped with a round knob, and is supported from beneath by additional detailing. The overall form is ornate and balanced, with the volume mostly centered vertically. The drawing is set on a cream-colored background and is enclosed within a light rectangular border. In the lower right corner of the page, there is a small, simplified line sketch of the same object, providing another view of its structure. A horizontal scale is located in the lower left corner, along with the word "SCALE" and an unreadable signature or note.
title: Brass Andiron
